page.subtitle: Architecture debt, per check: what it is now, what is frozen, and which way it moved

prov.collectionFailed: The newest collection failed: {reason}. Every row below is this collection's own answer — blank means "not measured", not 0.
prov.collectionFailedNoReason: The newest collection failed and the snapshot did not say why. Every row below is this collection's own answer — blank means "not measured", not 0.

note.singlePoint: The archive starts here: one collection so far, so a trend has to wait for a second.

legend.actual: "Now" is the number the check itself reported
legend.notCollected: Not collected: this check is missing from that run — never written as 0
legend.frozen: "Frozen" is the exemptions registered in the baseline, which is not how much is owed
legend.ruleChanged: Rule change: the deciding files changed, so the two sides are not compared
legend.newExemptions: New exemptions: the frozen count rose — a decision, not a discovery
legend.stale: Stale exemption: registered, but nothing in the tree matches it any more
legend.failed: Failed collection: that run collected nothing

value.noSecondPointHint: Only one point under the same rule, so there is nothing to compare
value.holeBlocksCompare: a collection in between was missed
value.holeBlocksCompareHint: A collection in between produced no number, and the comparison stops there — a change measured across it would be one nobody collected

detail.stale: Stale exemptions (registered, nothing left to match)
detail.noDetails: This check reports no per-item detail

area.scenes: Frontend scenes that run on their own

check.sceneRatchet: Scenes that run on their own

tree.line: {offenders} files in the whole tree are over their cap, {lines} lines over in total
tree.unknown: This collection did not measure the tree's sizes

pull.done: {listed} artifacts on CI, {stored} newly stored, {already} already archived
pull.unreachable: Nothing pulled: the request itself failed — check the server.

state.emptyDesc: The archive has no records at all. Press to pull one from CI; if the pull fails it says why instead of drawing "all clear".
state.loadFailed: The archive could not be read
state.loadFailedDesc: This is a read failure, not "nothing collected yet" — two different things, two different sentences.
state.noMeasurementsFailed: The most recent collection failed: {reason}. None of the most recent {count} collection(s) left a usable measurement — blank means "not measured", not 0.
state.noMeasurementsPlain: None of the most recent {count} collection(s) left a usable measurement — blank means "not measured", not 0.

foot.source: The checks and their rules live in the repository ({repo}); this page only draws the numbers they report.
